decks.notes: This vintage 1 vs 1 combo deck focuses on utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to generate massive card advantage and mana while setting up powerful win conditions like Time Vault and Lórien Revealed. The deck includes efficient counterspells and disruptive spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect its combo pieces. The inclusion of key artifacts like Black Lotus, Moxen, and Tolarian Academy help to accelerate the deck's game plan, while tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor provide consistency. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. It aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage with cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by recurring low-cost permanents. The deck's goal is to establish control of the game and grind out a victory through attrition and resource management.

The key strategy of this deck is to play disruptive creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent's game plan while still maintaining an aggressive edge with Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer. The deck also utilizes powerful hate cards like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like March of Otherworldly Light and Witch Enchanter provide card advantage and utility to keep up the pressure. The deck aims to control the game while maintaining a strong offensive presence.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Paradoxical Outcome card to generate large amounts of mana and card advantage by bouncing artifacts back to hand. It includes a variety of fast mana cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to quickly ramp up and cast multiple spells in a turn. The deck also includes powerful card draw and tutoring effects to find key combo pieces quickly. The goal is to assemble a powerful board state and win the game through a combo finish or overwhelming advantage generated by card draw and mana production.

The deck is focused on using artifacts and spells to quickly assemble a powerful combo involving Coveted Jewel. By ramping up mana with artifacts like Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith, the deck aims to cast cards such as Paradoxical Outcome to draw into key pieces like The One Ring or Tinker to search for Time Vault. Once the combo is assembled, the deck can generate a significant advantage by untapping Coveted Jewel multiple times per turn, allowing the player to draw cards, gain mana, and put pressure on the opponent to find answers quickly.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Lavinia. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while drawing cards and generating card advantage with powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. The inclusion of a companion like Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing you to recur key cards from your graveyard. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of efficient threats and powerful disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures to dominate the opponent's game plan. With a blend of card advantage, disruption, and efficient threats, it aims to control the tempo of the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run. The deck includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Snapcaster Mage to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By leveraging its control tools strategically, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through superior resource management and decision-making.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Oko, Thief of Crowns, while also using Oath of Druids to cheat massive creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal, while also setting up game-winning plays with cards like Show and Tell and Tinker. By efficiently managing resources and using a variety of powerful spells, this deck seeks to outmaneuver and overwhelm the opponent in a Vintage 1 vs 1 match.

The deck also includes various powerful spells and mana acceleration cards like Tinker and Black Lotus to further enhance its control and combo potential. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm helps protect the deck's strategy and disrupt opponent's game plan.Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and control the game through efficient and powerful plays.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with Dredge cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, enabling powerful graveyard recursion with cards like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam. Using cards like Noxious Revival and Serum Powder to manipulate the top of the library, the deck aims to create explosive combos with cards like Hollow One and Creeping Chill. Disruptive cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation are used to protect against opponent's disruption, while cards like Grief and Chalice of the Void help control the opponent's board and hand.

The deck focuses on utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes various control elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Show and Tell can also be used to put high-impact cards into play quickly. The deck features a mix of powerful spells and mana acceleration cards to help achieve its game plan efficiently. Ultimately, the goal is to control the game's tempo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells.

The key strategy of this deck is to fill the graveyard with Dredge cards like Golgari Thug and Stinkweed Imp, while also utilizing cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect the combo pieces. Combining cards like Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam to deal damage and bring creatures back from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, using cards like Hollow One and Grief to apply pressure early in the game while maintaining a strong graveyard presence to consistently bring back threats.

The deck focuses on assembling the Doomsday combo quickly and efficiently in order to win the game. It includes key cards such as Dark Ritual, Doomsday, and Thassa's Oracle to set up a winning sequence of cards from the library. The deck also includes a variety of tutors, draw spells, and counterspells to ensure the combo can be executed successfully while disrupting opponent's strategies. With a mix of fast mana, card selection, and protection, the deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The presence of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds resilience and consistency to the deck. The deck also includes countermagic like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect key plays and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The use of Mishra's Bauble and Gitaxian Probe provides additional information and card selection. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through controlling the board and maintaining card advantage.

The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional value by allowing the player to continuously recur low-cost permanents from their graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control throughout the game.
